description: A table its author wrote and left empty is a table that is there. `check` names a file that holds neither `packages` nor `modules`, because a table spelled `packagez` validates and is read as no table at all — but that message is read off what the file *names*, never off what its tables came to. Read off the count instead and a file holding an empty `packages` is told it holds no `packages`, which sends its author to write a second one; the same reading told a project that colors only ambient modules the same thing about `modules`. Both spellings are asserted by what the report must *not* say, since the fix is a line that is no longer there.
